questions.question: In his letter to Gaius, what did the elder say gave him no greater joy?

answers.text: Hearing that his children walk in the truth
Seeing his churches grow in number
Hearing that his letters were read aloud

questions.question: The elder praised Gaius for helping traveling brothers. What made Gaius's faithfulness to them especially notable?

answers.text: They were old friends of his

questions.question: In the elder's letter to Gaius, what did Diotrephes do to church members who wanted to welcome traveling brothers?

answers.text: Forbade them and put them out
Warned them but let them go ahead
Asked the elder to settle it by letter
